title: Bill Gates warns about the catastrophic risk posed by "people with ill intent using the latest AI tools", which are powerful enough to "cause a billion deaths" (Herb Scribner/Axios)
summary: Herb Scribner / Axios: Bill Gates warns about the catastrophic risk posed by “people with ill intent using the latest AI tools”, which are powerful enough to “cause a billion deaths” — Bill Gates will warn on this weekend's “Meet the Press” that he can see a future where AI wipes out humanity.
contentText:
Herb Scribner / Axios :

Bill Gates warns about the catastrophic risk posed by “people with ill intent using the latest AI tools”, which are powerful enough to “cause a billion deaths”   —  Bill Gates will warn on this weekend's “Meet the Press” that he can see a future where AI wipes out humanity.
